description_en: Mounts a specified PolarLakebase instance to a PolarDB application
description_zh: 将指定的Polarlakebase实例挂载到PolarDB应用
name: AttachApplicationPolarFS

parameters.help_en:
The PolarLakebase cold storage instance ID.

Currently, only the following applications support cold storage instances:
supabase
parameters.help_zh:
Polarlakebase 冷存版实例ID

目前仅如下应用支持冷存版实例
supabase
parameters.name: polar_fs_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID of the Alibaba Cloud account or RAM user. Ensure that the account or RAM user is authorized when you create the PolarLakebase instance
parameters.help_zh: 用户主账号或子账号的AccessKeyID，请确保创建Polarlakebase实例时已为该主账号/子账号授权
parameters.name: polar_fs_access_key_id

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey secret of the Alibaba Cloud account or RAM user
parameters.help_zh: 用户主账号或子账号的AccessKeySecret
parameters.name: polar_fs_access_key_secret

parameters.help_en: The mount point of the file system visible in the application container. If this parameter is not specified, the default value /mnt/<PolarFSInstanceId> is used for the first mount. For subsequent mounts, the current mount point of the instance remains unchanged. The value must be an absolute path that starts with a forward slash (/) but cannot be the root directory (/). It can only contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and forward slashes (/). The total length cannot exceed 128 characters, the directory depth cannot exceed 6 levels, and the length of a single level cannot exceed 63 characters. The mount point cannot be identical to or a subdirectory of the mount points of other file systems under the same application
parameters.help_zh: 应用容器内看到该文件系统的挂载点。不传时，首次挂载使用默认值 /mnt/<PolarFSInstanceId>，重复挂载则保持该实例当前的挂载点不变。必须是以 / 开头的绝对路径且不能是根目录 /，仅支持字母、数字、'.'、'_'、'-' 和 '/'，总长度不超过 128 个字符、层级不超过 6 层、单层不超过 63 个字符，且不能与同一应用下其他文件系统的挂载点重复或相互包含
parameters.name: container_mount_path

ContainerMountPath.description_en: The actual container path to which the file system is mounted. If ContainerMountPath is not specified, the effective default value /mnt/<PolarFSInstanceId> is returned. If the file system is repeatedly mounted without changing the path, the original mount point of the instance is returned
ContainerMountPath.description_zh: 该文件系统实际挂载到的容器路径。未指定 ContainerMountPath 时返回生效的默认值 /mnt/<PolarFSInstanceId>，重复挂载且未改路径时返回该实例原有的挂载点

PolarFSInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the PolarLakebase instance
